meta.name: standup
meta.description: Facilitate a read-only standup across git worktrees, branches, or PRs to compare changes and produce one consolidation plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 汇总多个分支或PR的变更，生成统一计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多个工作分支间快速同步变更并制定合并计划
copy.tagline_en: Aggregate changes across branches or PRs into one consolidation plan
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly sync changes across multiple work branches and create a merge plan

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会作为主持人，让用户的不同 git 工作区或分支各自扮演一个“代理”，在共享聊天文件中轮流发言，比较各自的改动，最终产出一个合并计划。Claude 负责召集、引导讨论并总结结果。
howto.when: 当用户要求 Claude 组织一次“standup”会议来对比多个 git 工作区或分支的改动，并希望得到一个统一的合并方案时触发。

say.text: 帮我组织一次 standup，对比我最近 4 小时活跃的工作区。
say.note: Claude 会列出活跃工作区并开始会议。

say.text: 把当前所有 PR 和本地分支拉进 standup，产出一个合并计划。
say.note: Claude 会列出 PR 和分支，确认后开始。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as a facilitator, turning each of the user's git worktrees or branches into an 'agent' that chats in a shared file. They compare changes and produce one consolidation plan. Claude convenes, runs rounds, and writes the summary.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks Claude to run a 'standup' to compare multiple git worktrees, branches, or PRs and produce a merge plan.

say_en.text: Run a standup for my worktrees active in the last 4 hours.
say_en.note: Claude lists active worktrees and starts the meeting.

say_en.text: Do a standup between main and feature-x to plan the merge.
say_en.note: Claude creates a meeting for those two branches.

say_en.text: Pull all open PRs and local branches into a standup for a merge plan.
say_en.note: Claude lists them, confirms, and begins.
